name: hcapp_getInviteCode
description: Returns a target user's invite code (URC: prefix) for sharing, subject to authorization rules: the target user must not have logged in yet, must not be removed, and the requesting user must have manage-members access flags on the target's home kennel. Returns 'No valid user' if any condition fails.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Device UUID of the requesting user.

parameters.name: targetUserId
parameters.description: The user whose invite code is being requested.

rowsets.name: NullUserError
rowsets.description: Returned when the device lookup yields no userId. Non-standard error format.

rowsets.name: AuthError
rowsets.description: Returned when CHECK_ACCESS_TOKEN_V2 fails. Non-standard error format.

rowsets.name: InviteCodeResult
rowsets.description: Always returned on successful auth. The result column contains either the invite code or 'No valid user' — both cases use the same column.

columns.name: result
columns.description: The URC: reset code if all conditions met, otherwise 'No valid user'.

codeSmells.detail: Error rowsets use Pascal-cased column names (ErrorType, ErrorTitle, ErrorDescription) without errorId or errorProc.

codeSmells.issue: Authorization failure encoded as string value — no error rowset
codeSmells.detail: 'No valid user' returned in same column as a valid code. Caller cannot distinguish auth failure from not-found from user-already-logged-in without parsing the string.
The bitflag check for admin authorization embeds an undocumented constant directly in the query. Should be a named constant or SP parameter.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change the 'No valid user' sentinel string without updating all callers
